changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/5793-spec-range-floors.md`

- names `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm-lock.yaml` — edited by this change

  > Nothing a consumer installs today changes: normal resolution already picks the newest 17.x, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` still resolves 17.2.0 on this edge after the bump. The change is to the declared floor only, which is why it is scored `patch` rather than `minor` — the same reasoning objectui#5753 used for the other direction on this dependency.

### `.changeset/6361-spec-floor-17-2-0.md`

- names `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm-lock.yaml` — edited by this change

  > Nothing a consumer installs today changes: normal resolution already picks the newest 17.x, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` still resolves `17.2.0` on both edges after the bump — only the recorded `specifier:` moves. No source and no behaviour changes, which is why this is scored `patch`, on the reasoning objectui#5793 used for the same remediation on `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.

### `.changeset/7122-objectstack-family-17-3-0.md`

- names `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `pnpm-lock.yaml` — edited by this change

  > `@objectstack/client`, `core`, `formula` and `lint` each pin `@objectstack/spec` EXACTLY, so resolving the spec alone to 17.3.0 left the console bundling TWO copies of it. Moving the family with it in `pnpm-lock.yaml` collapses the duplicate; every declared range already admitted 17.3.0, so no manifest moved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `a2f361b8c` (merge-base with origin/main): 3 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1569 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2156 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36293837119)

### ① Derived judgments

**The gate (fresh worktrees, zero `node_modules` directories, verified by `find`).**
- Merge-base `ee6f6c6a45`, no-install: exit 1 — `❌  check-vi-mock-specifiers: 1 mock resolves to no file on disk` / `- apps/console/src/__tests__/filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx -- vi.mock("../../../../packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl/dist/maplibre.js")` / `tried 24 path(s)`.
- Head, no-install: exit 0 — `✅  check-vi-mock-specifiers: OK (5622 tracked source file(s), 3794 test-named; 857 carry a mock; 1190 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1235 bare (out of scope), 0 non-static, 4 embedded in a string literal, 3 via the import() form).` Installed at head: exit 0, identical line. `check-vi-mock-inherit` no-install at head: exit 0 (`884 inherit, 0 auto-mocked`). `check-vi-mock-override-shape` no-install: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` (needs `typescript`); installed: exit 0 — the body states this correctly.
- `git grep` at head for `vi.mock|vi.doMock|vi.importMock|vi.importActual` with a relative specifier containing `node_modules`: zero hits. The only remaining `node_modules/react-map-gl` string is a fixture literal in `scripts/__tests__/vite-maplibre-worker.test.ts`, not a mock.

**The mock is real (installed head worktree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`, 6.8 s, 0 dirty tracked paths; every vitest leg under `os-verify-lock.sh`, invoked from the repo root as AGENTS.md prescribes).**
- Sweep at head: `Tests 72 passed (72)`, exit 0. Test blob `962494d19a`, ObjectMap blob `fbede2de83`.
- `vi.mock` block deleted (on disk: `vi.mock(` count 0, 7 deletions): `Tests 1 failed | 71 passed (72)`, the cell `'object-map (inline)' … CONTROL: a token-free filter reaches the query unchanged`, `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'destroy')`. Restored by `git checkout HEAD --`, blob `962494d19a` equal to HEAD, dirty 0. Load-bearing: yes.
- `git apply -R` of `f9c06ef6a`'s ObjectMap hunk (on disk: `queryFilter` 0, `useResolvedFilter` 0, `schema.filter` 7, blob `3c59cd6219`, `4 insertions(+), 18 deletions(-)`): `Tests 6 failed | 66 passed (72)` — exactly `object-map (object)` and `object-map (inline)` on USER, ORG and REBUILD (`sent the literal token`, `re-queried on a re-render`); every other row green. Restored, blob `fbede2de83` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, re-run `72 passed`. The mock bites, with no `dist/` leg: the root alias maps `@object-ui/plugin-map` to `packages/plugin-map/src`, the console vite config's `workspaceAliases` does not override it, and the src mutation reddened without a rebuild.
- Extra leg the body did not run: the BASE test file (old relative specifier, blob `d387d2a1c0`) on head's install: `72 passed` — so the old mock was installed at runtime (given no-mock is red), confirming H2's premise by a second route.
- Resolution: `realpath apps/console/node_modules/react-map-gl` and `realpath packages/plugin-map/node_modules/react-map-gl` are the same `node_modules/.pnpm/react-map-gl@8.1.2_maplibre-gl@6.4.1_react-dom@19.2.8_react@19.2.8__react@19.2.8/node_modules/react-map-gl`; `ls node_modules/.pnpm | grep -c '^react-map-gl@'` is 1; Node ESM `import.meta.resolve('react-map-gl/maplibre')` from both package directories lands on the same real `dist/maplibre.js`; `maplibre-gl` realpath is one `maplibre-gl@6.4.1` under both. No vitest or vite alias names `react-map-gl` or `maplibre` (the root `vitest.setup.base.ts` mocks `maplibre-gl` globally, seen alike by both packages).

**The dependency.**
- `^8.1.2` is exactly `packages/plugin-map/package.json`'s range (its `dependencies`, beside `maplibre-gl ^6.4.1`).
- Lockfile diff merge-base to head: one hunk `@@ -328,6 +328,9 @@ importers:`, three added lines under the `apps/console` importer (`react-map-gl:` / `specifier: ^8.1.2` / `version: 8.1.2(maplibre-gl@6.4.1)(react-dom@19.2.8(react@19.2.8))(react@19.2.8)`), zero lines outside `importers:`; `packages:` and `snapshots:` carry one `react-map-gl@8.1.2` entry each before and after, and `packages/plugin-map`'s importer names the same version string. `check:lockfile-integrity` (`VERDICT clean`, 1773 resolutions both sides) and `check:lockfile-dedupe` (`VERDICT deduped`) exit 0 no-install and installed. `.npmrc` has only `auto-install-peers=true` and `engine-strict=true`; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets no peer or dedupe option; `maplibre-gl` is `optional: true` in the lockfile's package entry, so the comment's "optional peer, deduplicated" is true.
- Installed gates at head, all exit 0: `check:unused-deps`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `changeset:check` (fixed and no-major), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (`1 added, 0 modified, 0 deleted`), `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; the three pending `pnpm-lock.yaml` claims it re-raised concern `@objectstack/spec` 17.x resolutions this hunk does not touch). eslint on the changed file: 0 errors, the one pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warning.
- Build output: NOT MEASURED locally. By construction unchanged: `git grep` finds no console source import of `react-map-gl`; a devDependency is not a build input; the only console config mention is `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE`, which per its own comment is read by `pnpm dev` only, never by `vite build` (observation: the devDependency now makes those two dev-only `include` entries resolvable from the app root; dev-server only). CI `Bundle Analysis` and `Build & E2E` success; the budget comment reads PASS at 3065.7 KB of 3104.5 KB.

**The comment in the test.** True in every clause: `ObjectMap.tsx` imports `react-map-gl/maplibre`; all 30 `plugin-map` tests mock that exact spelling and no other; the gate's header names bare specifiers as out of scope (objectui#5646); the workflow runs the checker after `setup-node` with no install; the pre-install failure is reproduced above.

**The changeset.** Empty frontmatter is the repo's first-class form: `check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s header ("An EMPTY frontmatter counts"; "A change confined to `src/__tests__/` is answered by the empty-frontmatter exemption"); 588 of the current `.changeset/*.md` files carry `---`/`---`. Why `apps/console/src` counts: `@object-ui/console` is in the `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json`, so clause (a) `PKG/src/**` guards it, while `devDependencies` in `package.json` are explicitly not guarded. Measured no-install at head with `--base ee6f6c6a45`: exit 0 (`1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed … EMPTY frontmatter … a complete answer`); with the changeset file moved away: exit 1 naming `@object-ui/console` and the test file — the declaration is owed, as the body says. The changeset prose is true (specifier, range, same store instance, the pre-install cause, nothing under `dist/` or `plugin.js`).

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — correct in substance. No released package's `dist/`, `plugin.js`, `exports`, `files` or runtime dependency moves; a devDependency of `@object-ui/console` reaches no consumer install. The empty-frontmatter changeset is the right declaration.

**Title and body against head, sentence by sentence.** Title: true. "Fixes #10731" and the objectui#10732 fold: true (10732 closed as duplicate at 03:20Z; its readings live in triage `5852234038`). What-changed bullets: all four true. H1 red line and `tried 24 path(s)`: reproduced. H2 load-bearing figures: reproduced at head. H3 realpaths, one store instance, no peer split: reproduced. H5 blobs, counts, `6 failed | 66 passed`, the six cells, restore: reproduced. Gates table exits: all reproduced. Serial: `origin/main` `ee6f6c6a45` to `10e9cc6ae3` is 39 files (verified; main has since moved one more commit to `a2f361b8c1`, 40 files, still none of the four); merge-tree clean against both. Three sentences are FALSE as written:

1. H1: "The same tree after `pnpm install`: exit 0, `check-vi-mock-specifiers: OK (5622 …; 1190 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1235 bare (out of scope), …)`." Those are HEAD's figures. At the base tree the mock is still relative, so the census reads `1191 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1234 bare (out of scope)` (measured at the merge-base with the target file present on disk; the checker judges disk existence only). Replacement: `check-vi-mock-specifiers: OK (5622 tracked source file(s), 3794 test-named; 857 carry a mock; 1191 relative specifier(s) resolved, 1234 bare (out of scope), …)`.
2. Clause-② line: "a private app's devDependency". `@object-ui/console` is not private — no `private` field, `publishConfig.access: public`, `files`/`main`/`exports` published, in the `fixed` group, CHANGELOG at 17.6.0 — and the body's own Acceptance notes call it "a published package". Replacement: `Clause-②: no — a test's mock specifier and a devDependency of @object-ui/console, which no consumer installs; no published surface moves`.
3. Gates table, `check:unused-deps`: "(the `vi.mock` specifier is a consumer under its rule 1)". False. Rule 1 reads the phantom-deps parser's specifier forms (import, export-from, import-equals, import()-type, dynamic import(), require()); run on the head test file it emits 16 specifiers, none `react-map-gl`; `consumedNames(root, 'apps/console')` has no `react-map-gl`. The gate is green because `devDependencies` are in `MEASURED_FIELDS`, not `GATED_FIELDS` — `react-map-gl` is one of its "59 dev declaration(s) [with] no consumer". Replacement: `(devDependencies are measured, not gated, by this script; react-map-gl in apps/console has no consumer the scan reads, since a vi.mock string is none of its specifier forms — the exit 0 says nothing about this declaration)`.

Nit: "objectui#8941 touches `apps/console/package.json` (the `lucide-react` range, an adjacent line)" — `lucide-react` sits four lines above `react-map-gl` in the same `devDependencies` block (8941's hunk context reaches `react-dom`, the line the new entry follows). Replacement: `(the lucide-react range, four lines above in the same devDependencies block)`.
